title: (FOTO in VIDEO) Pred državnim zborom protestniki proti vladi in odlokom, policisti so jih popisali
location: Trg republike, Ljubljana, in front of the National Assembly
organizer: Civil initiative Maske dol; Večer identifies Anica Bidar as the protest coordinator.
threshold_50_evidence: The contemporary report says more than 100 people gathered, which clearly exceeds 50; no exact lower or upper count is imposed.

start_date.summary: Večer dates the gathering to 13 January; Nova24 reports that the Trg republike protest began around 14:00.

end_date.summary: Večer reports that the crowd dispersed after less than two hours and that Bidar called for dispersal around 15:30. Nova24 reports police repeated dispersal calls and that most attendees left after Bidar’s call; the exact final departure time is not stated.

location.summary: Both reports place the gathering at Trg republike in Ljubljana, in front of the National Assembly.

organizer.summary: Večer and Nova24 identify the Maske dol initiative and Anica Bidar; Ljubljanainfo is an advance notice and does not confirm occurrence.

demands.summary: The reports describe opposition to the pandemic decrees/restrictions, a call for normal life, and a demand for government/political resignation; these map to social_restrictions and political_behavior_process.

participants_original.summary: Večer states that more than 100 people gathered.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The report's 'more than 100 people' description is above the 50-person threshold.

protester_violence.summary: No affirmative account of participant violence is established; the article's quoted expectation of a peaceful event is not proof of no violence.

state_response.accommodation.summary: The report describes no meeting or acceptance of demands; whether accommodation occurred is unknown.

state_response.arrests.summary: Police identified participants and discussed fines, but the report does not establish whether anyone was detained or arrested.

state_response.beatings.summary: The report does not establish beatings or affirm that none occurred.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: Večer reports police dispersal orders and an attempted removal; Nova24 reports repeated police calls for attendees to disperse. This records an attempted mechanism, not proof that police cleared the crowd.

state_response.ignore.summary: The report does not establish whether authorities ignored any demands.

state_response.killings.summary: No event-linked killing evidence is reported; absence from this account is not coded as no_explicit.

state_response.shootings.summary: No event-linked firearm shooting evidence is reported; absence from this account is not coded as no_explicit.

notes: This was a Wednesday gathering organized by Maske dol. Večer and an advance Ljubljanainfo article say the Friday cycling protest organizers distanced themselves, so the event is not automatically joined to the recurring bicycle actions. The state target is the Slovenian government and its domestic decrees. A separate opened Nova24TV report also confirms the gathering and its approximate start, but gives no crowd count and references social-media/RTV material; Večer remains the sole opened source providing an explicit above-50 estimate.
open_questions: Follow the January 8, 15, 22, and 29 cycling actions to keep their physical episode boundaries distinct.
Seek another independently sourced attendance estimate; the opened Nova24 report gives no count and references other media material.

title: Protest against the eviction and destruction of the Rog autonomous spaces
location: Former Rog factory, Trubarjeva Street, Ljubljana
organizer: Unclear for the 18:00 rally. Ohranimo Tovarno Rog circulated a call; Protestna ljudska skupščina held an afternoon press conference.
participants_original: Regional Obala reports around 200 people at the protest by 18:00; it separately reports several dozen additional people at the site earlier, not summed.
threshold_50_evidence: The article reports around 200 people at the 18:00 protest, above 50. Earlier people at the eviction site are not added to that estimate.

start_date.summary: The source reports protest activity at the former factory and a public protest gathering by 18:00 on 19 January 2021. It does not establish an exact start time for the broader action.

end_date.summary: The source gives no physical departure or dissolution for the crowd; the event end is unknown.

location.summary: The report places eviction-related protest activity at the former Rog factory in Ljubljana and states around 200 people gathered there by 18:00.

organizer.summary: The report shows a call circulated under Ohranimo Tovarno Rog and says Protestna ljudska skupščina held an afternoon press conference, but does not identify the organizer of the 18:00 crowd.

demands.summary: The call and statements opposed the municipal eviction/demolition and sought preservation of autonomous spaces; the municipality is the direct policy target.

participants_original.summary: Around 200 people were reported at 18:00; an earlier 'several dozen' at the eviction site are a separate mention and are not summed.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The reported around-200 crowd at 18:00 exceeds 50.

protester_violence.summary: The source describes attempts to enter/re-enter a fenced site and tension, but does not establish a violence code for the public protest; remains unknown.

state_response.accommodation.summary: No authority meeting or acceptance of demands is reported; the later mayoral response is not treated as accommodation.

state_response.arrests.summary: Police reported ten people detained during the morning eviction intervention; S044’s partially inspected STA-attributed text repeats this morning account. Neither source establishes that detentions occurred within or against the separate ~200-person crowd reported by 18:00, so arrests remain unknown for this candidate.

state_response.beatings.summary: The article records an MP allegation of excessive police force/truncheons and activist injury claims concerning the morning eviction intervention. Its relation to the later ~200-person crowd is unestablished, so beatings remain unknown for this candidate.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: The reported police orders and force were part of clearing the site during the morning eviction intervention. No source establishes an order or force directed at the later ~200-person crowd; crowd_dispersal remains unknown for this candidate.

state_response.ignore.summary: Whether authorities ignored the demands is unknown; silence in this article is not coded as ignore.

state_response.killings.summary: No event-linked killing evidence is reported; this is not treated as explicit absence.

state_response.shootings.summary: No firearm shooting evidence is reported; this is not treated as explicit absence.

notes: The source reports a morning eviction response and a public protest of around 200 by 18:00 at the same site; whether those actions are one physical episode is unclear. The event's physical end is not reported. Keep this distinct candidate and the 22 January march under the same tentative campaign key without merging or assigning official IDs. The approximately 200-person figure belongs to the gathering reported by 18:00. The ten detentions, one police-reported injury and contested force allegations refer to the morning eviction intervention; because physical continuity between the morning site defenders and evening crowd is not established, these responses are preserved as morning context but not assigned to this candidate’s crowd-response fields.
open_questions: Did the eviction-site protest physically dissolve on 19 January?
Were morning site defenders and the 18:00 crowd one event or separate gatherings?
Did the January 22 march begin after a physical break, or was it continuous with the January 19 gathering?
Check December and February activity for physical continuation.
The opened same-headline Regional Goriška page has a T.K./Uredništvo/STA byline; determine whether it republishes S016, and seek evening physical-end evidence from another source.
The morning eviction intervention generated detention and force reports; are any response facts attributable to the separate ~200-person crowd reported by 18:00?

title: (VIDEO) Zvečer krenil protest za Rog. Policija spet uporabila solzivec, po ljubljanskih ulicah odmevalo "policisti teroristi"
location: March from Prešeren Square through central Ljubljana toward Rog and Trubarjeva Street
organizer: Facebook event "Ohranimo tovarna Rog"; a single organizer is not named. Delo also says AKC Metelkova and Friday cyclists expressed support.
participants_original: Večer describes several hundred and quotes police as saying around 500; 24ur/STA reports 500–600; Reporter repeats the around-500 police estimate; Svet24 attributes roughly 1,000 to TV Slovenija; Delo's independent reporter describes several hundred. Preserve the source attributions and conflict without calculating a bound or total.
threshold_50_evidence: All described estimates exceed 50; source and agency dependence is unresolved.

start_date.summary: Večer and the opened Ljubljanainfo account place the gathering at Prešeren Square around 18:00 on 22 January 2021.

end_date.summary: Večer and Ljubljanainfo quote police as saying the crowd dispersed around 20:00; the exact time of physical departure is not given.

location.summary: The march ran from Prešeren Square through Ljubljana toward City Hall and Rog/Trubarjeva Street.

organizer.summary: 24ur reports a Facebook event named Ohranimo tovarna Rog; Delo describes support from AKC Metelkova and the Friday cyclists. Support does not establish shared organizing or continuity with their recurring actions.

demands.summary: Participants opposed eviction and demolition at the Rog autonomous cultural space, called on the municipality to leave autonomous spaces alone, and demanded a different housing policy; this is coded provisionally as a demand on municipal policy.

participants_original.summary: Reported estimates range from several hundred and around 500/500–600 to about 1,000 attributed to TV Slovenija. Ljubljanainfo repeats a several-hundred STA estimate and police estimate around 500; these are not treated as independent added counts. Dependencies remain unresolved.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: All reported estimates exceed 50; the Ljubljanainfo several-hundred estimate is attributed to STA and its approximately 500 figure to police, not treated as a new independent count.

protester_violence.summary: The article reports crowd pressure/pushing at a police cordon but does not establish participant violence as a coded event response.

state_response.accommodation.summary: The article reports no authority meeting or acceptance of demands; accommodation remains unknown.

state_response.arrests.summary: Večer and Ljubljanainfo report one detention, with the latter quoting police; source dependence is unresolved.

state_response.beatings.summary: The article reports shield-pushing and pepper spray and says no bodily injury was recorded; it does not specifically establish beatings, so the field remains unknown.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: The article quotes police describing shield-pushing and pepper spray at Trubarjeva and says the crowd dispersed around 20:00; this supports an attempted dispersal. The account repeats police information.

state_response.ignore.summary: The article does not establish whether authorities ignored any demands.

state_response.killings.summary: No event-linked killing evidence is reported; absence from this account is not coded as no_explicit.

state_response.shootings.summary: Pepper spray/tear gas are reported, but no firearm shooting is established; no inference is made from these chemical irritants.

notes: A new public march is described on 22 January, but the eviction and on-site mobilization reported for 19 January may be part of the same physical sequence. Keep the candidate separate and pending unit ownership until the January 19 onset and neighboring dates are checked. The police account and journalist/social-media accounts are contained in one Večer article and are not independent confirmations. The opened Ljubljanainfo report also quotes STA and police; it is retained as a separate source card but not counted as an independent turnout or response confirmation.
open_questions: Was there a physical break between the 19 January Rog crowd and the 22 January march?
24ur displays a 15:37 page timestamp while reporting an 18:00 start and post-event details; the publication/update chronology remains unresolved.
The 22 January sources contain several turnout estimates and overlapping text; identify source/agency dependencies before treating them as independent.
Delo reports support from AKC Metelkova and Friday cyclists; this does not establish physical continuity with earlier actions.
Seek separate contemporary corroboration of the reported police response and the 19 January crowd's departure.
The Ljubljanainfo account repeats STA and police details; verify its source dependence before treating it as independent corroboration.

title: Trbovlje protest against renewed school closures
organizer: Unknown; the source does not identify a specific organizer.
participants_original: Around 200 residents are reported at the 30 January Trbovlje gathering by Siol/STA, 24ur, Delo/STA, Reporter and Večer; these overlapping reports are not independent by default.
threshold_50_evidence: The reported attendance was around 200, clearly over 50; no bound is inferred from the approximate figure.

start_date.summary: The opened 24ur report dates the Trbovlje gathering to 30 January 2021.

end_date.summary: No source reports when this Saturday crowd physically departed or dissolved. Later home visits/fines and the separate Sunday protest do not establish its end time.

location.summary: The crowd gathered on the steps by Delavski dom in Trbovlje.

organizer.summary: 24ur says a local group of residents described the event and its demand on Facebook; it does not name the group.

demands.summary: The source reports a demand that schools reopen after closure was announced; this maps to social_restrictions.

participants_original.summary: Siol/STA and other reports say around 200 attended; the opened bylined 24ur report also reports around 200. These estimates are not added and cross-outlet dependence remains unresolved.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The around-200 estimate in the opened 24ur report independently supports a crowd above 50 at the Trbovlje steps; the other approximate reports are preserved but not added.

protester_violence.summary: The opened 24ur report explicitly describes the event as a peaceful protest; no affirmative participant-violence account was found for this gathering.

state_response.accommodation.summary: Later political statements and a separate public appeal are reported, but no meeting or accepted demand for this Saturday gathering is established; unknown.

state_response.arrests.summary: Some participants were reportedly visited at home and fined after the action. Fines do not establish arrests, and no arrest account or explicit denial is given; unknown.

state_response.beatings.summary: No beating account or explicit denial is reported for this gathering; unknown.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: The sources describe later home visits and fines but do not report that police warned or physically moved the 30 January Trbovlje crowd; unknown.

state_response.ignore.summary: Whether authorities ignored this gathering's demands is unknown; later fines and public comments do not resolve the field.

state_response.killings.summary: No event-linked killing is reported; this is not coded no_explicit.

state_response.shootings.summary: No event-linked firearm shooting is reported; this is not coded no_explicit.

notes: The opened 24ur bylined account reports around 200 people, names a local residents' Facebook group as the source of the demand, and describes the gathering as peaceful. The similar estimates in other outlets are not added or presumed independent. This is the Saturday 30 January physical gathering, separate in date from Sunday's multi-city actions in E004; shared campaign identity and exact episode rules remain unresolved.
open_questions: When did the 30 January Trbovlje crowd physically depart?
What was the legal basis and exact date of each later home visit or fine?
Do the coding rules treat the later Sunday actions as a shared campaign, separate city events or a broader episode?
Does the local residents' Facebook group named by 24ur overlap with organizers of the Sunday multi-city actions?
The Q019 Siol and Reporter Trbovlje pages remain unread after Cache miss and are not used as independent evidence.

title: Protests against renewed school closures across several cities
location: Sunday 31 January gatherings reported in Koper and Portorož, Ljubljana, Maribor, Kranj, Celje, Trbovlje, Zagorje ob Savi, Hrastnik, Hrpelje, Pivka, Krško, Idrija, Brežice and Slovenska Bistrica; city coverage varies by source.
scope: Multi-site actions; a single national coordination structure is not confirmed.
organizer: Parent-led calls spread through social media are reported, and a Zasavje civil initiative is named; one organizer coordinating every city is not established.
participants_original: City reports vary in scope: Siol/STA gives several hundred in Koper, around 100 in Ljubljana, 50 in Maribor, 200 in Kranj and 100 in Celje; Reporter gives several hundred in Koper and the same estimates for other named cities; Mladina cites a Koper figure above 700 from Primorske Novice; Večer reports more than 1,000 across Koper/Portorož and about 150 in Hrpelje. These local estimates are not summed.
threshold_50_evidence: Multiple independently named gatherings exceed 50 in the cited reports, including Koper, Ljubljana, Kranj, Celje and Hrpelje. The approximate 50 figure for Maribor is not relied on to establish the threshold. No cross-city total is calculated.

start_date.summary: The reports date this set of Sunday actions to 31 January 2021; they do not establish a single national start time or that all locations began together.

end_date.summary: The reports do not establish when the crowds physically departed in the named locations. Dispersal requests in parts of Zasavje do not prove successful clearing or an event-wide end date.

location.summary: Reports name Koper/Portorož, Ljubljana, Maribor, Kranj, Celje, Hrpelje, Trbovlje, Zagorje ob Savi, Hrastnik, Pivka, Krško, Idrija, Brežice and Slovenska Bistrica, with coverage varying by article; no national attendance total is given.

organizer.summary: Several reports describe calls by parents spreading through social media. Reporter names a Zasavje initiative. No evidence establishes one body coordinating all listed cities.

demands.summary: Participants called for reopening schools and nurseries and objected to renewed closure in affected regions; this maps to social_restrictions.

participants_original.summary: Siol/STA reports several hundred in Koper, around 100 Ljubljana, 50 Maribor, 200 Kranj and 100 Celje. Reporter reports several hundred in Koper and similar estimates for the four cities. Mladina cites above 700 in Koper from Primorske Novice. Večer reports above 1,000 across Koper/Portorož and separately 150 in Hrpelje. The estimates differ by source and geographic scope and are not added.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The reported estimates for Koper, Ljubljana, Kranj, Celje and Hrpelje each exceed 50. The approximate Maribor estimate is not needed for eligibility; no sites are summed.

protester_violence.summary: No event-wide finding on participant violence is established; unknown.

state_response.accommodation.summary: Officials made public comments, but the sources do not establish a meeting or acceptance of the demonstrators' demands; unknown.

state_response.arrests.summary: No arrest account or explicit denial is reported for the Sunday actions; some reports discuss fines after the separate Saturday Trbovlje gathering. Sunday arrests remain unknown.

state_response.beatings.summary: No Sunday beating account or explicit denial is reported; unknown.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: Reports say police asked crowds to disperse in some Zasavje locations, including Zagorje/Hrastnik and related Sunday activity in Trbovlje. This supports an attempted dispersal mechanism; the sources do not establish whether the orders succeeded.

state_response.ignore.summary: Whether the state ignored any Sunday demands is unknown; public statements do not establish acceptance or refusal.

state_response.killings.summary: No event-linked killing is reported; this is not coded no_explicit.

state_response.shootings.summary: No event-linked firearm shooting is reported; this is not coded no_explicit.

notes: This record describes a set of same-day local gatherings sharing a school-reopening demand, not a proven single nationwide event. Media-derived and local counts vary; Koper figures may refer to different places or coverage and are preserved without reconciliation or summation. E005 is the separate Saturday Trbovlje physical gathering; the shared campaign key remains tentative.
open_questions: Was there one parent call coordinating all sites or separate city initiatives?
Which source and time window supports each Koper/Portorož attendance estimate, and do these refer to the same venue?
What are the city-specific physical end times and outcomes of the Zasavje dispersal requests?
Do the original unit rules code this multi-site set as a single episode or separate local events?
Q019 found additional Koper parent-call/Svet24 headlines; the relevant bodies were not assessed, so these leads do not establish attendance, organizer, or city-level coordination.

A search-only Publishwall compilation includes a 31 January local-action post naming Koper and other sites, but authorship and coordination are unverified; it does not establish a single national event.

title: Friday protest walks and activity at Trg republike

scope: Reported multi-city Friday action; a single national gathering is not established.
organizer: A public statement and a social-media post by activist Jaša Jenull are mentioned; one organizing body across all locations is not established.
participants_original: No count provided. Delo describes individual walks rather than a conventional gathering and also mentions additional people at Trg republike without quantifying them.
threshold_50_evidence: No public gathering of 50 or more is established; the event remains pending_threshold because Delo mentions unspecified presence at Trg republike while describing the broader action as individual walks.

end_date.summary: The article does not report when the walkers or any people at Trg republike physically left; end date unknown.

location.summary: The article reports individual walks in Ljubljana and other cities, and describes additional people at Trg republike in Ljubljana without quantifying them.

organizer.summary: A public statement and a post by activist Jaša Jenull are referenced, but a single organizer for the multi-city activity is not established.

demands.summary: The article describes an anti-government protest aligned with objections to government restrictions; categories political_behavior_process and social_restrictions remain provisional pending fuller source attribution.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No count or clear qualitative estimate establishes a public gathering of at least 50. The source distinguishes individual walks from a conventional gathering; any crowd at Trg republike is unquantified. Eligibility remains pending_threshold.

protester_violence.summary: No event-specific finding on protester violence is established; unknown.

state_response.accommodation.summary: No meeting or acceptance of demands is reported; unknown.

state_response.beatings.summary: No beating account or explicit denial is reported; unknown.

state_response.killings.summary: No event-linked killing is reported; this is not coded no_explicit.

state_response.shootings.summary: No event-linked firearm shooting is reported; this is not coded no_explicit.

notes: Delo reports Friday protest activity on 8 January but says it took the form of individual walks, not a conventional gathering. It also notes additional people at Trg republike without a count.
